text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate (model: v3f) starting 09:12:36 UTC. Paging on-call @Miguel. Root: spike in latency + kv_cache errors.

Miguel: on it, grabbing graphs and logs now. I see a sharp uptick in 503/504 across edge nodes.

Sasha: looks correlated with requests that have long prefixes (>2048). stack traces point to kv cache eviction mismatch on v3f runtime.

Miguel: top keys by qps: mobile-prod (38%), web-prod (22%), internal-qa (8%). A handful of heavy keys are dominating.

Lina: proposal: hot-swap heavy traffic to a known-stable backstop variant (backstop-v2.9) that has a smaller memory footprint and avoids the kv path that's failing. Do partial routing, not full cutover.

Sasha: agree. We can do weighted routing and emergency per-key throttles simultaneously. Will prepare commands.

Miguel: capacity check: Dedicated pool can absorb ~60% of this route for 30m before we need to scale. I'll reserve that headroom.

Sasha: executing weighted route update now.

Sasha: ```
# rdwctl traffic split
rdwctl route update --from-model v3f --to backstop-v2.9 --weights 60:40 --reason "emergency hot-swap: kv_cache_mismatch"
```

OpsBot: applied routing change. traffic split: backstop-v2.9=0.60, v3f=0.40. no autoscale triggered.

Miguel: applying emergency per-key rate limits for the top offending keys to lower tail latency.

Sasha: ```
# emergency quota updates
rdwctl quota set --key mobile-prod --rps 200  # was 800
rdwctl quota set --key web-prod --rps 150     # was 400
```

OpsBot: quotas updated: mobile-prod=200 rps, web-prod=150 rps.

Grace: pinging Support / Sales: sending a short note to top affected customers that we're diverting heavy traffic to a fallback variant to restore stability.

SupportBot: message sent to SRE-customer-updates channel + created ticket INC-2026-312 in Zendesk.

Patrick: quick customer impact note — mobile-prod customers might see increased latency/queued requests for 30m. Keep me posted and I'll join the call if needed.

Miguel: monitoring metrics now. initial 5xx rate was 4.8% across the service layer; 10 minutes after the change it's down to 0.6%. Good signal.

Lina: can we capture a short eval on backstop outputs for quality regression? need to ensure no client-facing semantic regressions. If quality is OK, plan to route more traffic back to v3f once root cause fixed.

Sasha: kicked off quick eval harness comparing 200 sample requests between v3f and backstop-v2.9. Results show stable parity for our high-level intents. no major hallucination increase.

Miguel: root cause triage ongoing — reproducer points to an ordering race in kv restoration after large prefix prompts. I can patch in staging but want to avoid a risky prod deploy.

Grace: operational decision for leadership: keep hot-swap for 45m, collect stability and perf metrics, then either widen v3f back up or extend backstop.

Patrick: I'll take on-call after @Miguel's handoff. Miguel, handover at 09:30 UTC?

Miguel: confirmed. Handoff to Patrick at 09:30 UTC. leaving a runbook note: "backstop hot-swap flow + quota rollback steps" in the incident ticket.

IncidentBot: Handoff recorded: Miguel -> Patrick at 09:30 UTC.

Sasha: note for rollback when safe: commands to revert routing and quotas.

Sasha: ```
# revert plan (if stable)
rdwctl route update --from-model v3f --to backstop-v2.9 --weights 90:10 --reason "gradual revert"
rdwctl quota reset --key mobile-prod
rdwctl quota reset --key web-prod
```

OpsBot: metrics snapshot: 5xx reduced to 0.6%, p95 latency improved by 220ms, backlog cleared on most nodes.

Patrick: taking over monitoring. If we maintain <1% 5xx for 45m, will start gradual cutover back to v3f. If errors spike again, we'll cut to 100% backstop and open a post-incident review.

Miguel: leaving trace links and logs in the ticket. follow-up: schedule fix PR for kv restore ordering once high-priority tasks allow.

Grace: thanks team, great fast mitigation. I'll coordinate external comms and update the status page. :thumbsup:

SupportBot: incident status: mitigated (partial: traffic hot-swapped to backstop variant + emergency quotas). Monitoring continues.

Patrick: acknowledged, monitoring takeover complete. will update last_message_ts when closing."
